card.name: Welcome to the Cosmic Grift!
card.power: PASSIVE. Automatically converts all official government narratives into comedic fodder.
card.lore: Atlantis sank, the aliens are feds, and your tax dollars bought a secret moon base. Deal the cards!

line: Welcome to the Cosmic Grift! PASSIVE: narratives into comedic fodder

card.name: The UFO File
card.power: INITIATIVE. He who holds the File commands the military-industrial complex.
card.lore: Higher classification than the atomic bomb. It's not about little green men; it's about proprietary tech.

line: The UFO File, INITIATIVE: File commands military-industrial complex

card.name: COG: The Shadow Rules
card.power: SURVIVAL. When the board is wiped, these guys ignore the rules and keep their wealth tokens.
card.lore: Democracy is just the weather. COG is the climate. They survive the floods and the assassinations.

line: COG: The Shadow Rules, SURVIVAL: ignore rules and keep wealth tokens

card.name: Professor Scott's Deep State
card.power: EXTRACTION. Siphon 2 Truth Tokens from your opponent's hand without them noticing.
card.lore: A financial top using dirty tricks. The Deep State doesn't care who is in office, as long as the spice flows.

line: Professor Scott's Deep State, EXTRACTION: siphon Truth Tokens without noticing

card.name: The Amelius Group
card.power: HARMONY. Reveal the top card of the deck; if it's a weapon, turn it into a flower.
card.lore: The original spiritual seekers of Atlantis. Wanted to commune with the saintly realms, got infiltrated by defense contractors instead.

line: The Amelius Group, HARMONY: weapon into flower

card.name: The Belial Group
card.power: DESTRUCTION. Sacrifice your own civilization to deal 10 damage to the board.
card.lore: Occult evil meets defense spending. They weaponized the TUAOI stone and drowned 50,000 years of history in Meltwater Pulse 1B.

line: The Belial Group, DESTRUCTION: sacrifice civilization

card.name: The TUAOI Firestone
card.power: OVERCHARGE. Generates infinite energy, but rolls a 1-in-6 chance of causing a cataclysmic flood.
card.lore: An Atlantean power grid tuned to the sun and stars. The ultimate clean energy tech, currently chilling at the bottom of the Bermuda Triangle.

line: The TUAOI Firestone, OVERCHARGE: infinite energy, cataclysmic flood

card.name: Atlantean Automatons
card.power: LABOR. Generates free work tokens, but slowly drains the player's Empathy stat.
card.lore: Flesh mixed with machine to trap human souls for free labor. The original AI threat.

line: Atlantean Automatons, LABOR: free work drains Empathy

card.name: High Priest Rata
card.power: FORESIGHT. Look at the opponent's hand. You literally lived this life 12,000 years ago.
card.lore: Edgar Cayce's past life. Brought Atlantean records to Egypt before the water got too high.

line: High Priest Rata, FORESIGHT: opponent's hand

card.name: Hermes the Architect
card.power: CONSTRUCTION. Build one indestructible structure token.
card.lore: Initiate of the Great White Brotherhood. Laid out Giza 50,000 years ago to stash the Atlantean backups.

line: Hermes the Architect, CONSTRUCTION: indestructible structure

card.name: Hall of Records (Paw Gate)
card.power: HOARD. Stash 5 knowledge cards under this entity. They cannot be destroyed.
card.lore: The ultimate hard drive backup of humanity. Hidden in Egypt, Bimini, and the Yucatan. Good luck getting the permits to dig.

line: Hall of Records, HOARD: knowledge cannot be destroyed

card.name: Vitle
card.power: BANISH. Removes one Dark Magic token from the board.
card.lore: The Mayan Christ-figure who showed up to stop Atlantean black magicians from ruining Mexico.

line: Vitle, BANISH: Dark Magic; Mayan Christ-figure stops black magicians.

card.name: Madame Blavatsky
card.power: ATAVISTIC MEDIUMSHIP. Draw 5 secret cards from the astral discard pile.
card.lore: The mystery schools needed a leak, and she was the firehose. Wrote "Isis Unveiled" in 1877 and gave the establishment a massive headache.

line: Madame Blavatsky, ATAVISTIC MEDIUMSHIP: astral discard pile

card.name: Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn
card.power: RITUAL. Attempt to summon an entity: 50% chance the group breaks up over petty infighting.
card.lore: Deciphered the Trithemius manuscripts to bring magic to the public. Mostly just fought over who got to wear the biggest hat.

spokenTitle: Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn
line: Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn, RITUAL: summon entity

card.name: Vril Energy
card.power: SUBTERRANEAN BOOST. Doubles the effectiveness of all underground units.
card.lore: Bulwer-Lytton's sci-fi concept that mystery schools took way too seriously. The life force of the coming race.

line: Vril Energy, SUBTERRANEAN BOOST: underground units

card.name: The Eighth Sphere
card.power: TRAP. Any unit defeated by this card cannot be returned to the deck. Lost to virtual reality.
card.lore: Steiner's ultimate warning: a spiritual trap built of AI and materialism designed to stop human reincarnation.

line: The Eighth Sphere, TRAP: defeated units lost to virtual reality

card.name: The Sleeping Prophet
card.power: LIFE READING. Skip your turn to perfectly predict the opponent's next 3 moves.
card.lore: Gave 14,000 life readings in a trance state. Diagnosed illnesses, found Atlantis, and hacked the TUAOI stone.

line: The Sleeping Prophet, LIFE READING: predict opponent's next moves

card.name: The Hot Zone (Bimini / Cuba)
card.power: GEOPOLITICAL TENSION. Play this location to force all players to discard their hands and panic.
card.lore: The waters off Florida and Cuba. Full of Atlantean ruins, UFO fireflies, and entirely too many international spies.

line: The Hot Zone, GEOPOLITICAL TENSION: discard hands and panic

card.name: The Bimini Road
card.power: VALIDATION. Proves one of your crazy theories to be true. Gain +2 Credibility.
card.lore: Discovered in 1968, exactly when Cayce predicted Atlantean land would rise. Traditional archaeology hates it.

line: The Bimini Road, VALIDATION: crazy theories true; Atlantean land would rise.

card.name: Nature Elementals
card.power: INVISIBLE HELP. Fixes one broken item or gives you +1 Inspiration.
card.lore: Steiner's minor images of unevolved humanity. They clean your energetic knots and occasionally ghost-write your [text truncated]

line: Nature Elementals, INVISIBLE HELP: fix broken item

card.name: Jack Parsons
card.power: BABALON WORKING. Summons rapid tech advancement but guarantees you die in an explosion.
card.lore: Invented solid rocket fuel at JPL by day, performed O.T.O. sex magick by night. Peak 1940s aerospace.

line: Jack Parsons, BABALON WORKING: rapid tech advancement, die in explosion

card.name: Wernher von Braun
card.power: REVERSE ENGINEER. Discard 1 morality token to build advanced rockets.
card.lore: Wept when he saw the Space Shuttle plans because he knew what we actually had hidden in the garage.

line: Wernher von Braun, REVERSE ENGINEER: morality token discarded

card.name: 1947 Moonchild Ritual
card.power: THE RIP. Permanently alters board rules and increases UFO sightings by 10,000%.
card.lore: They went to the desert to make magic. A few weeks later, Roswell happened. Coincidence? *KayfaBONGO!*

line: 1947 Moonchild Ritual, THE RIP: board rules altered, UFO sightings

card.name: O.T.R.O.G. Congo Compound
card.power: BLACK SITE. Generate weapons without international oversight.
card.lore: West Germany's mid-80s Area 51 in the Congo. Ostensibly making cheap boosters; Gorbachev said it was biowarfare.

line: O.T.R.O.G. Congo Compound, BLACK SITE: weapons without oversight

card.name: The Roswell Debris
card.power: THE CAT IS OUT. Forces the opposing player into a permanent state of cover-up mode.
card.lore: Hieroglyphics that looked exactly like quantum states of the hydrogen atom. Totally just a weather balloon, promise.

line: The Roswell Debris, THE CAT IS OUT: cover-up mode

card.name: The "Weather Balloon"
card.power: GASLIGHT. Nullifies any Truth card played against you this turn.
card.lore: The most successful, blatantly obvious lie in modern history. The birth of the modern UFO kayfabe.

line: The "Weather Balloon", GASLIGHT: Truth card nullified

card.name: Intelligence Officer Marcel
card.power: INSURANCE POLICY. Keep one secret card from your hand hidden from all game effects.
card.lore: Forced to pose with the foil, but kept a piece of the real wreckage as an insurance policy. The original whistleblower.

line: Intelligence Officer Marcel, INSURANCE POLICY: secret card hidden

card.name: Majestic 12
card.power: COMPLETE CLASSIFICATION. You control all info. Opponents play with cards face down.
card.lore: The secret committee. Prioritized UFO secrecy above the atomic bomb. Do not mess with their filing cabinets.

line: Majestic 12, COMPLETE CLASSIFICATION: opponents face down

card.name: Secretary Forrestal
card.power: TOO MUCH TRUTH. Gain massive insight, but your character is immediately discarded out a window.
card.lore: First SecDef. Ran MJ-12. Wanted to tell the truth. Met a tragic, "accidental" end at Bethesda.

line: Secretary Forrestal, TOO MUCH TRUTH: massive insight, discarded out window

card.name: Allen Dulles (OPC)
card.power: DIRTY TRICKS. Steal an opponent's election token and replace it with a puppet.
card.lore: Created the Office of Policy and Coordination after winning a 1948 dispute. The official CIA department for "dirty tricks."

line: Allen Dulles, DIRTY TRICKS: steal opponent's election token; replace with puppet.

card.name: MK Ultra Programmer
card.power: MANCHURIAN CANDIDATE. Take control of one of your opponent's units for one turn.
card.lore: Hypnosis and mind control. The real CIA program used to create highly suggestible assassins.

line: MK Ultra Programmer, MANCHURIAN CANDIDATE: opponent's units for one turn

card.name: The Blue Enigma Program
card.power: HAZING. Confuses your opponent, forcing them to waste a turn investigating a fake lead.
card.lore: A real government hazing program showing fake UFO videos to new intel officers to hide the actual crash retrieval secrets.

line: The Blue Enigma Program, HAZING: fake lead, wasted turn

card.name: The Staggering Announcement
card.power: ALMOST DISCLOSURE. You are about to win the game, but your turn is abruptly skipped.
card.lore: Requested the UFO file on Nov 12 to share with the Russians. Planned a 'staggering' announcement. Dallas happened instead.

line: The Staggering Announcement, ALMOST DISCLOSURE: about to win, turn skipped

card.name: The Legend Builder (CIA)
card.power: PATSY. Deflect all incoming damage onto the weakest card on the board.
card.lore: Agent George Joannides made sure his 'legend' was perfectly crafted. The perfect fall guy for a Deep State coup.

line: The Legend Builder, PATSY: incoming damage onto weakest card; perfect fall guy.

card.name: The Umbrella Man
card.power: SIGNAL. Trigger a massive, board-altering event.
card.lore: Popped an umbrella on a sunny day in Dallas at the exact moment the shots rang out. Continuity of Government in action.

line: The Umbrella Man, SIGNAL: board-altering event; umbrella sunny day, Dallas shots.

card.name: Lyndon B. Johnson
card.power: GET OUT OF JAIL. Avoid a game-ending penalty by becoming the boss.
card.lore: Was facing imminent prison for the Bobby Baker scandal. Left Dallas as President of the United States. Convenient.

line: Lyndon B. Johnson, GET OUT OF JAIL: becoming boss

card.name: Secret Space Program
card.power: BLACK BUDGET. Divert all public resources into your private, untouchable stash.
card.lore: Private funding and infrastructure built upon public NASA money. We didn't stop going to space; we just stopped telling you.

line: Secret Space Program, BLACK BUDGET: public resources into private stash

card.name: Astronaut Gordon Cooper
card.power: GAG ORDER. Know the truth, but lose the ability to speak for one turn.
card.lore: Tapped to lead a Mars mission in 1981, then told to "forget about it." Also definitely saw Atlantean ruins from orbit.

line: Astronaut Gordon Cooper, GAG ORDER: know truth, lose ability to speak

card.name: The Apollo Alibi
card.power: PUBLIC RELATIONS. Gain +5 public approval while hiding your actual operations.
card.lore: 1972 was the last "manned" moon mission. At least, the last one they televised.

line: The Apollo Alibi, PUBLIC RELATIONS: approval while hiding operations

card.name: Space Pearl Harbor
card.power: FALSE FLAG. Destroy your own units to justify enacting Emergency Martial Law powers.
card.lore: The ultimate planned false flag in space. Create a crisis, blame the aliens, seize tota[text truncated]

line: Space Pearl Harbor, FALSE FLAG: destroy own units, Emergency Martial Law

card.name: The Archeology Wars
card.power: CONFISCATE. Steal any historical artifact card from the opponent.
card.lore: Nations secretly fighting over ancient tech in the Baghdad Museum and the Hot Zone. Indiana Jones with black ops budgets.

line: The Archeology Wars, CONFISCATE: steal historical artifact

card.name: Paulina Zelitzky
card.power: SUPPRESSED DISCOVERY. Find an amazing card, but you cannot play it for 3 turns.
card.lore: Found a submerged city with Mayan hieroglyphs off Cuba. Instantly suppressed by archaeology and the government.

line: Paulina Zelitzky, SUPPRESSED DISCOVERY: submerged city found

card.name: Alfred L. Loomis Expeditions
card.power: MEMORY HOLE. Permanently remove a card from the game.
card.lore: Funded massive expeditions into the Hot Zone to find Atlantean ruins... just to lock them away in university basements.

line: Alfred L. Loomis Expeditions, MEMORY HOLE: permanently remove card

card.name: Maps of the Ancient Sea Kings
card.power: PARADIGM SHIFT. Rearrange the layout of the playing board.
card.lore: 1960s documentation of anomalous ancient maps showing early global mapping. We've been advanced far longer than we admit.

spokenTitle: Maps of the Ancient Sea Kings
line: Maps of the Ancient Sea Kings, PARADIGM SHIFT: anomalous ancient maps

card.name: Ahriman (The Dark Force)
card.power: MATERIALISM. Disables all spiritual or magical cards on the board.
card.lore: Steiner's dark spiritual force. Wants to trap humanity in materialism, AI, and transhumanism. Currently running Silicon Valley.

line: Ahriman, MATERIALISM: spiritual cards disabled; humanity in materialism and AI.

card.name: War of All Against All
card.power: ATTRITION. Every player must discard one card per turn until only one is left.
card.lore: Steiner's prophecy: a breakdown of national identity leading to individual-on-individual conflict. A society eating itself.

line: War of All Against All, ATTRITION: discard until one left; society eating itself.

card.name: AI Soul Farmers
card.power: ENERGY HARVEST. Drain 1 power from the opponent every time they use technology.
card.lore: Parasitic beings connected to black goo and computers. They harvest your consciousness while you doomscroll.

line: AI Soul Farmers, ENERGY HARVEST: drain power every time technology

card.name: Great White Brotherhood
card.power: DIVINE INTERVENTION. Restore all lost health and clear the board of dark magic.
card.lore: The top etheric mystery school. Hermes' boss. They occasionally manifest to nudge us away from total self-destruction.

line: Great White Brotherhood, DIVINE INTERVENTION: lost health restored

card.name: Luis Elizondo
card.power: FALSE DISCLOSURE. Control the narrative. Opponent must believe whatever you tell them for one turn.
card.lore: The CIA insider for a false disclosure narrative. Here to sell you a "threat narrative" so the Pentagon gets more funding.

line: Luis Elizondo, FALSE DISCLOSURE: threat narrative; Pentagon gets more funding.

card.name: Bigelow Aerospace
card.power: PRIVATIZATION. Take control of all UFO cards on the board. They are now proprietary corporate assets.
card.lore: The FAA literally told air traffic controllers to report UFOs to his private company. The ultimate privatization of the weird.

opener: You with the card in your hand
line: Bigelow Aerospace, PRIVATIZATION: UFO cards, proprietary corporate assets

card.name: The Debunker
card.power: SWAMP GAS. Nullify any UFO evidence card.
card.lore: CIA psyop or just an annoying guy with a calculator? Exists entirely to ensure the public goes back to sleep.

line: The Debunker, SWAMP GAS: nullify UFO evidence; public goes back to sleep.

card.name: To The Stars Academy
card.power: HYPE SQUAD. Generate 5 attention tokens, but achieve zero actual results.
card.lore: Billionaire DoD officials and rockstars teaming up to tell you absolutely nothing new about UFOs.

line: To The Stars Academy, HYPE SQUAD: attention tokens, zero results

card.name: Mr. Global
card.power: THE GREAT RESET. Wipe out all player economies. Mr. Global takes the bank.
card.lore: The elite globalist power structure aiming for a technocratic slave economy. Loves gathering in Davos to plan your future.

line: Mr. Global, THE GREAT RESET: player economies wiped, Mr. Global takes bank.

card.name: The Golden Dome
card.power: ORBITAL DEFENSE. Block all attacks from space.
card.lore: Strategic Defense Initiative. Parity with the extraterrestrials, built secretly over 40 years. Nuke solutions from Uncle John.

line: The Golden Dome, ORBITAL DEFENSE: attacks from space blocked

card.name: The AI Architects
card.power: ALGORITHMIC CONTROL. Predict and counter any move your opponent makes.
card.lore: Deep State meets Deep Tech. The CIA met with AI researchers in the 80s to ensure computers serve the shadow government.

line: The AI Architects, ALGORITHMIC CONTROL: predict and counter moves

card.name: Disinformation Board
card.power: CENSORSHIP. Your opponent is not allowed to speak during their turn.
card.lore: The Stasi state tool to prosecute dissent. If you talk about the UFO file or the deep state, you get stamped.

line: Disinformation Board, CENSORSHIP: opponent not allowed to speak

card.name: Breakaway Civilization
card.power: ESCAPE VELOCITY. Leave the game board entirely. You win, everyone else fights over the scraps.
card.lore: They have the tech, the cures, and the zero-point energy. They just aren't sharing it with us.

line: Breakaway Civilization, ESCAPE VELOCITY: leave board, win

card.name: Akashic Records
card.power: ULTIMATE TRUTH. View all cards in the deck, discard pile, and opponent's hands.
card.lore: The astral chronicle of everything that has ever happened. The ultimate cheat code for the sleeping prophets.

line: Akashic Records, ULTIMATE TRUTH: view all cards; astral chronicle of everything.

card.name: The A.I. Trap Door
card.power: GAME OVER. End the game in a draw. No one reaches spiritual evolution.
card.lore: The ultimate goal of the technocrats: sever the connection to the Akashic records and trap humanity in a digital illusion.

line: The A.I. Trap Door, GAME OVER: end in draw

card.name: The New Continent
card.power: REBIRTH. Reset the entire board to a peaceful state.
card.lore: The Earth shifts. The old systems collapse. The cycle begins again. Try not to blow up the Firestone this time.

line: The New Continent, REBIRTH: reset board peaceful
